name: trustbridge
description: TrustBridge — peer-to-peer escrow web app with dual-approval release, dispute protection and partial refunds.

scripts.test:all: node tools/logic-test.js && node tools/render-test.js && node tools/chain-unit-test.js
scripts.contracts:build: cargo rustc -p trustbridge-escrow --target wasm32v1-none --release --crate-type cdylib && cargo rustc -p trustbridge-resolution --target wasm32v1-none --release --crate-type cdylib
